components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default action: quiet at rest, softer on hover, and tactile on press.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { appearance: none; display: inline-flex; height: 36px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 10px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 14px/20px "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: The neutral secondary action with a structural border and micro lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { appearance: none; display: inline-flex; height: 36px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 10px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font: 500 14px/20px "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A labeled search field with compact geometry and an explicit focus halo.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--foreground); font: 500 14px/20px "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { appearance: none; width: 100%; height: 36px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 10px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font: 400 14px/20px "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 20%, var(--input)); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Evidence Badge
components.description: A neutral pill for compact evidence annotations and readiness labels.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; min-height: 28px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 5px 12px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font: 500 12px/16px "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-badge:hover { background: var(--muted); color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-badge:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Standard Card
components.description: A flat bordered surface for focused workflow content.
components.html:
EXPORT

Streaming exports

Review service-specific matches before exporting.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); font-family: "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; color: var(--foreground); font-size: 22px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 28px; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-card p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; }

components.name: Empty Work Area
components.description: A dashed, spacious placeholder for the next meaningful workflow action.
components.html:
Find an artist

Search for an artist to generate a setlist-informed playlist.
components.css: .ds-empty { display: flex; min-height: 280px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px dashed var(--border); border-radius: 10px; padding: 48px; background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); text-align: center; font-family: "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-empty h3 { margin: 0; color: var(--foreground); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 24px; } .ds-empty p { max-width: 360px; margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; }

components.name: Product Navigation
components.description: The 72px fixed shell with a compact brand mark and quiet navigation.
components.html:
EEncore
HomeAppProfile
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; min-height: 72px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 0 32px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font: 500 14px/20px "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: var(--muted-foreground); text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible, .ds-nav a.ds-current { color: var(--foreground); } .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--foreground) !important; font-weight: 600; } .ds-brand span { display: grid; width: 32px; height: 32px; place-items: center; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--foreground); color: var(--background); font-size: 12px; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 32px; } .ds-nav button { height: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 10px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font: inherit; } .ds-nav button:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible, .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Playlist Evidence Row
components.description: The signature comparison row for rank, song identity, source evidence, and confidence.
components.css: .ds-track { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 32px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--secondary); padding: 12px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font-family: "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-track:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--muted) 55%, var(--background)); } .ds-track > div { min-width: 0; } .ds-rank { color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 16px; } .ds-track strong { display: block; overflow: hidden; color: var(--foreground); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 20px; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-track small { display: block; overflow: hidden; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-score { padding: 4px 10px; background: var(--card); color: var(--success); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 20px; }

components.name: Metric Tile
components.description: A compact evidence tile for matched, review, skipped, and excluded counts.
components.css: .ds-metric { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font-family: "Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-metric strong { display: block; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 28px; } .ds-metric span { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; }

narrative.overview:
Encore is a practical, evidence-rich companion for preparing for a concert. Its visual system behaves like a well-edited field guide: clear enough to scan at a glance, structured enough to inspire trust, and detailed enough to reward closer inspection. Graphite typography, porcelain surfaces, and fog dividers keep the interface precise and restrained without becoming anonymous.

The shell stays quiet so the product can become expressive at the right moment. Interactive demonstrations, live confidence feedback, and purposeful motion carry the delight. Surfaces rest flat and ordered; hover, press, focus, drawer, and reveal states answer the user with crisp, satisfying feedback.
keyCharacteristics: Evidence-first hierarchy with bold, tightly tracked headings.
Graphite, Porcelain, and Fog neutrals as the persistent visual foundation.
Fine borders and generous whitespace instead of constant elevation.
Semantic color reserved for success, review, warning, and error.
Interactive product moments as the primary source of delight.

rules.name: The Quiet Shell Rule
rules.body: Neutral roles own the interface; functional color appears only when it communicates state or evidence.

rules.name: The Feature Pop Rule
rules.body: A special visual surface may become expressive for an interactive product moment, but that expression must remain concentrated rather than spreading across every card.

rules.name: The Confident Compression Rule
rules.body: Large headings are heavy and tightly tracked; supporting copy stays regular-weight with comfortable line height.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Inter Variable throughout. Create hierarchy through the established roles instead of introducing a decorative display face.

rules.name: The One Clear Split Rule
rules.body: Use a single structural divider to explain a major workspace relationship; do not nest card grids when whitespace and one rule can establish the hierarchy.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A card does not receive a shadow merely because it is a card. Elevation is reserved for temporary layers or a deliberately featured moment.

rules.name: The Radius Ladder Rule
rules.body: Keep controls tighter than cards and cards tighter than pills. Do not apply the largest radius indiscriminately.

rules.name: The Satisfying Response Rule
rules.body: Every interactive component must answer hover, keyboard focus, active press, selection, or open state without requiring decorative animation at rest.

dos: Do keep Graphite, Porcelain, and Fog dominant on every operational screen.
Do concentrate visual delight in interactive product demonstrations, evidence feedback, and purposeful state transitions.
Do use borders, whitespace, and alignment before reaching for elevation.
Do keep confidence, appearance counts, and review status easy to compare.
Do preserve reduced-motion behavior for nonessential entrance animation.
donts: Don't use streaming-provider branding as Encore's ambient visual identity.
Don't place an ambient shadow under every card or section.
Don't scatter semantic colors as decoration when no state is being communicated.
Don't substitute nested cards for a clear grid, divider, or whitespace relationship.
Don't make a clean surface inert; interactive states should still feel deliberate and responsive.
